`desloppify plan show` currently reports `1770` skipped total, but that splits into `1484` already-permanent `wontfix` items and `286` still-temporary items. All `286` temporary items belong to that one coverage cluster. Its temporary skip reason is: “Bot is actively backfilling tests on this branch.”

The `286` break down as:
- `161` `transitive_only`
- `114` `placeholder`
- `9` `untested_module`

I would not mark the whole cluster permanent `wontfix`.

Why:
- It’s a mixed bag. Some items are obvious low-value coverage noise like config/theme/mocks, but others are real production-surface tests.
- Some entries are already stale because we added tests during this pass without rescanning, for example [useFormSubmission.test.ts](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/ImageGenerationForm/hooks/useFormSubmission.test.ts), [persistOptimisticReferenceSelection.test.ts](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/ImageGenerationForm/hooks/referenceUpload/persistOptimisticReferenceSelection.test.ts), and [useStyleReferenceUploadHandler.test.ts](/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/ImageGenerationForm/hooks/referenceUpload/useStyleReferenceUploadHandler.test.ts).
- A blanket permanent skip would freeze both low-value noise and still-meaningful gaps together.

My recommendation is:
- Leave the cluster deferred for now if you want to preserve the exact stop point from this pass.
- On the next cycle, either rescan and let stale entries disappear, or split this cluster and permanently `wontfix` only the low-value config/mock/transitive noise.
